info.name: FloodPulse API Validation Lab
info.description:
Reproducible API testing and validation lab for Karnataka AI Flood Intelligence & Early-Warning System (Phase 2.3).

Validates official endpoints across:
- 01_IMD (India Meteorological Department)
- 02_CWC (Central Water Commission / NWIC)
- 03_NRSC_NDEM (National Database for Emergency Management)
- 04_Bhuvan (ISRO Geoportal)
- 05_India_WRIS (Water Resources Information System)
- 06_Karnataka_OGD (Karnataka Open Government Data / OpenCity)
- 07_Open_Meteo (Operational NWP & Reanalysis Feeds)
- 08_OSM (OpenStreetMap / Overpass API)

Adheres strictly to the zero-fabrication data policy: no mock responses, real HTTP status codes, and exact field specifications.

item.name: 01_IMD
item.description:
Official India Meteorological Department (IMD) API Management Gateway endpoints.

Authentication: Requires API key obtained via official registration on https://api.imd.gov.in/public/register.php (restricted to government/institutional domains: gov.in, nic.in, cdac.in).
Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401 Unauthorized with {"error":"API key missing"}.

request.description:
### IMD AWS/ARG Real-Time Station Telemetry
- **Endpoint**: `https://api.imd.gov.in/api/v1/aws_data?sid=13`
- **State**: Karnataka (sid=13)
- **Authentication**: Required (API key missing -> 401)
- **Expected Response**: HTTP 401 Unauthorized without key; JSON array of AWS station observations with key
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 401 Unauthorized
- **Important Fields**: `Station_ID`, `Station_Name`, `Date`, `Time_UTC`, `Rainfall_mm`, `Temp_degC`, `Humidity_pct`, `Wind_Speed_kmph`
- **Units**: Rainfall in mm, Temp in °C, Wind in km/h
- **Status**: CREDENTIAL_BLOCKED / DOCUMENTED_ONLY

exec: pm.test("Status code is 401 without API key", function () {
pm.test("Response returns API key missing error", function () {

item.name: 02_CWC
item.description:
Central Water Commission (CWC) & National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC) datasets.

Open CKAN REST API (`https://nwdp.nwic.gov.in/api/3/action/`) and public CSV datasets for reservoirs and river water level gauges.

request.description:
### NWIC CKAN Package Search
- **Endpoint**: `https://nwdp.nwic.gov.in/api/3/action/package_search`
- **Access**: Open HTTP GET
- **Expected Response**: HTTP 200 OK with list of packages and resource download URLs
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 200 OK (45 packages found for Karnataka)
- **Discovered Products**: Karnataka Reservoir Telemetry, Rainfall Manual Daily (1900-2030), Discharge Gauge Daily, Minor Irrigation Tanks
- **Status**: VERIFIED

### Karnataka Dam Telemetry Dataset
- **Resource**: `karnataka_man_reservoir_data.csv` (16.4 MB, updated daily)
- **Coverage**: 14+ major Karnataka dams (Almatti, KRS, Kabini, Tungabhadra, Bhadra, etc.), 1990-2026
- **Columns**: `Reservoir Name`, `Basin`, `Sub Basin`, `River`, `Monitoring Date`, `Percentage Full`, `Reservoir Level (ft)`, `Gross Capacity (TMC)`, `Inflow (Cusecs)`, `Outflow to River (Cusecs)`
- **Conversion Factor Requirements**:
  - Level: ft -> metres (x 0.3048)
  - Capacity: TMC -> MCM (x 28.3168)
  - Inflow/Outflow: Cusecs -> m³/s (x 0.0283168)
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 206 Partial Content / HTTP 200 OK
- **Status**: VERIFIED

exec: pm.test("CSV headers contain reservoir metrics", function () {

item.name: 03_NRSC_NDEM
item.description:
National Database for Emergency Management (NDEM) — NRSC / ISRO.

Restricted access platform: Full geospatial services, flood inundation layers, and decision-support databases require authorized government agency credentials (NDMA, SDMAs, MHA) with multi-factor authentication. No public open REST API exists.

Status: PORTAL PRODUCT — MACHINE-READABLE ACCESS NOT CONFIRMED / CREDENTIAL_BLOCKED.

request.description:
### NDEM Portal Verification
- **URL**: `https://ndem.nrsc.gov.in/`
- **Access Policy**: Restricted government portal.
- **Status**: CREDENTIAL_BLOCKED / PORTAL ONLY
- **Note**: Cannot be consumed as an open unauthenticated REST API.

item.name: 04_Bhuvan
item.description:
ISRO Bhuvan Geoportal (National Remote Sensing Centre).

Hosts satellite imagery, thematic maps, and disaster visualization portals. Vector WMS services (`bhuvan-vec2`) are firewall-restricted or timed out from non-institutional networks. The Next.js web portal (`bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/ngmaps`) is active.

request.description:
### Bhuvan Next.js Geoportal Entry Point
- **URL**: `https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/ngmaps`
- **Response**: HTTP 200 HTML / Next.js React application bundle
- **Status**: PORTAL ONLY — Visualization interface

item.name: 07_Open_Meteo
item.description:
Open-Meteo Weather Forecast, Historical Archive, and GloFAS Flood APIs.

Provides operational numerical weather prediction model output (ECMWF, GFS, ICON) and ERA5 reanalysis without credentials.

request.description:
### Operational Weather & Precipitation Forecast
- **Endpoint**: `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast`
- **Target**: Mysuru, Karnataka (12.2958, 76.6394)
- **Variables**: `temperature_2m` (°C), `precipitation` (mm), `rain` (mm), `relative_humidity_2m` (%), `wind_speed_10m` (m/s), `surface_pressure` (hPa)
- **Units**: Strictly matches `DATA_CONTRACT.md` SI units
- **Temporal**: Current + 72 hourly timestamps (ISO 8601 UTC)
- **Attribution**: Must be recorded as `source="open_meteo"` (MODEL_OUTPUT)
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 200 OK
- **Status**: VERIFIED (Primary Operational)

exec: pm.test("Response contains current and hourly precipitation", function () {

item.name: Historical Reanalysis Daily Rainfall (2023 Flood Window)

request.description:
### Historical Daily Weather Archive (ERA5 Reanalysis)
- **Endpoint**: `https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive`
- **Coverage**: 1940 to present (tested July 2023)
- **Fields**: `precipitation_sum` (mm), `rain_sum` (mm), `temperature_2m_max` (°C), `temperature_2m_min` (°C)
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 200 OK
- **Status**: VERIFIED

### GloFAS Gridded River Discharge Forecast
- **Endpoint**: `https://flood-api.open-meteo.com/v1/flood`
- **Source**: Copernicus GloFAS seamless integration
- **Variables**: `river_discharge`, `river_discharge_mean`, `river_discharge_max`, `river_discharge_min`
- **Units**: `m³/s` (matches `_m3s` contract)
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 200 OK
- **Status**: VERIFIED (Forecast Reference)

item.name: 08_OSM
item.description:
OpenStreetMap / Overpass API.

Used strictly for supporting spatial facilities (hospitals, clinics, fire stations, police stations).

CRITICAL POLICY: OSM places tagged `shelter` are NEVER imported as official flood relief shelters. Only hospitals, fire stations, and police stations are retrieved from OSM.

request.description:
### OSM Emergency Facilities: Healthcare
- **Endpoint**: `https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter`
- **Bounding Box**: Mysuru Urban (`[12.28, 76.60, 12.33, 76.68]`)
- **Headers**: Custom User-Agent mandatory (returns 406 without it)
- **License**: ODbL
- **Target Entity**: `EmergencyFacility` (`facility_type="hospital"`)
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 200 OK
- **Status**: VERIFIED

### OSM Emergency Facilities: Fire Stations
- **Endpoint**: `https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter`
- **Target Area**: Belagavi Urban
- **Target Entity**: `EmergencyFacility` (`facility_type="fire_station"`)
- **Actual Tested Status**: HTTP 200 OK
- **Status**: VERIFIED
